Find the function that merges per-request and session mappings, with per-request values winning and None-valued keys removed. Return an object containing path and symbol. Answer only JSON with key answer.

Find the two test functions that directly exercise parsing Content-Type parameters and choosing an encoding from response headers. Return a sorted array of file::function strings. Ignore tests of other encoding helpers. Answer only JSON with key answer.

Answer only JSON with status done.
